theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cidc_dilation_isIntegerMultiplicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
